text:
maya: Quick heads-up — odd behaviour in the JS SDK when using jsonMode + function/tool calling in our sample app. If an auth refresh happens mid-call the helper returns an empty parsed object even though the retried response includes the structured JSON. Repro below.

ash: Which SDK version and small repro? :eyes:

maya: repro (JS, sdk@0.24.0):
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true });
const resp = await client.callFunction('cart.get', { cartId: 'u-42' }, { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { products: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { sku: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['sku'] } } }, required: ['products'] } });
// If the access token expired: first attempt -> 401, SDK refreshes token and retries.
// Expect: resp.parsed.products = [{ sku: 'T-1000' }]
// Seen: resp.parsed === {}  // parsed object empty
```

sam: Can you log the final response text around the retry path? If the raw body has JSON then the issue is definitely in the parse guard.

maya: I added console.log in the retry handler. The retried response body contains the correct JSON payload. The parser seems to short-circuit when a previous attempt set an auth-error flag.

lia: That matches a bug I fixed in the Python helper last month. We had an `hadAuthError` flag that prevented parse from running in the final success path. Workaround for now: disable jsonMode in the sample or do manual JSON.parse(resp.rawBody) after the call.

ash: I'll pick this up. Patch idea: ensure any transient error flags are cleared before the final parse step, and add a unit test that simulates 401 -> refresh -> 200 with jsonMode + schema validate. Also double-check streaming responses (buffer flush).

sam: note: streaming path is trickier because chunks might be dropped if the guard bypasses the stream consumer. Add an integration test that asserts the streamed JSON reconstructs correctly after a retry.

devex-bot: Issue created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/1312 — "JS SDK: jsonMode parse skipped after auth refresh during function call" by maya. Labels: devex, bug, needs-triage.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the onboarding sample-app README to call out the temporary workaround and link to the issue so new devs don't get blocked. :thumbsup:

ash: quick note for the patch — prefer resetting the parse guard near the HTTP client retry loop instead of deep in the parser to avoid duplicate state paths.

lia: added a short unit test snippet to the issue for parity across JS/Py.

maya: awesome, appreciate it. Will follow the PR and revert the README note when the fix lands.
